# `assets/weapon/WeaponStateMachine.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/weapon/WeaponStateMachine.js`

engine/assets/weapon/WeaponStateMachine.js — a small, deterministic weapon state machine: idle ⇄ firing ⇄ empty, with reloading. It models a magazine + a chambered round (total = ammo + chambered) and auto-cycles a fresh round after each shot, so dry-fire, last-round, and reload-from-empty all behave correctly. GAME ABSTRACTION ONLY — no real-firearm mechanism is modelled.

## Functions

### `createWeaponStateMachine(init = {})`

**Parameters:**

- `init` *(object)* — { capacity, ammo, chambered, fireMode }

- `WEAPON_STATE`
- `WEAPON_INPUT`
